findings.description: Optional ONNX sidecar uses mutable mcr.microsoft.com/onnxruntime/server:latest tag (not digest-pinned). Guarded behind dev-only 'embeddings' profile, inactive in production.
findings.remediation: Pin ONNX image by tag@sha256 if/when the embeddings profile is used; keep out of production.

findings.description: MCP Streamable-HTTP endpoint (:48721) has no documented app-layer authn/authz; mitigated by loopback port binding (PUBLISH_HOST default 127.0.0.1) and internal bridge network.
findings.remediation: Capture MCP access control / network segmentation as a Phase 6.7 deployment-security requirement. No code change required in SA4E-335.

findings.description: No explicit Pino secret-redaction paths or MCP tool-execution audit logging in this diff. Out of this containerization ticket's scope.
findings.remediation: Specify Pino redaction keys + MCP tool-invocation audit logging in the deployment review.

findings.description: AD-6 draw.io/Electron/X11/xvfb + model pre-cache available behind build args but DEFAULT OFF (SEC-08); default production image excludes them.
findings.remediation: Keep AD-6 default-off; isolate diagram export in a separate image/sidecar if ever needed. Already correctly defaulted off.

secretScan: no committed credentials (only *.example placeholders; real secret files git-ignored)
